name: How long does it take to install molding in a typical basement?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install molding in a typical basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of basement molding installation depends on the size of the basement, the complexity of the layout, and the type of molding being installed. A small, straightforward basement might take 1-2 days, while a larger or more intricate project with multiple rooms and detailed trim work could extend to 3-5 days. This estimate includes preparation, installation, and initial finishing like caulking. We'll provide a more accurate timeline after assessing your specific basement dimensions and project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time for basement molding ranges from 1-5 days, depending on basement size and project complexity.
